title: User Command V2.2
description: DRAFT, not published. What a participant asks the Secretary of a meeting (a request, UserCommandRQ) and what the Secretary answers (a response, UserCommandRS) under the same UserCommandID. Exactly one of the two is present, as in the User Command (CAE-UCM). The Secretary is a User (a Process) that speaks with the User of a participant; its Voice Command Interface turns what the participant says into the request.

UserCommandRQ.description: A request: one or more of the fields below. A field that is absent asks nothing.

Summary.description: A summary of the meeting so far, for the participant that asks, and for nobody else. Language and Form are given when the participant says them; otherwise they are the ones of the earlier request, or English and spoken.

Form.description: Written: the text is shown on the participant's display. Spoken: the Secretary reads it aloud (not in Japanese or Chinese: no voice speaks them, the text is shown).

Display.description: Hide: the summary on the display goes away. StopReading: the Secretary stops reading the summary.

Answers.description: How the Secretary answers the participant from now on: Spoken (the default, in a few words) or Written (also on the display).

Hand.description: Raises or lowers the participant's hand: asks for the floor.

Microphone.description: Switches the participant's microphone on or off.

Screen.description: Starts or stops sharing the participant's screen in the room. Only the convener may share.

CloseMeeting.description: True: the convener closes the meeting, for everybody. The Secretary asks to be sure before it is done.

Confirm.description: True: yes, to the question the Secretary asked last (closing the meeting). False: no.

ReturnToMeeting.description: True: the participant is done with the Secretary, and what it says is heard by the room again.

UserCommandRS.description: How the request was carried out.

Outcome.description: Asked: the Secretary needs the participant to confirm first.

Reason.description: Why the action was not done.

Summary.description: The summary made, when the request asked for one and it is to be shown.

Language.description: ISO 639-1 code: English, Greek, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese.
